He also says the tech industry needs to do a better job explaining the benefits of data centers to local communities and how physical AI could become a major driver of US economic growth. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Core CPI Hikes Ahead of FOMC Meeting
title_cn: 联邦公开市场委员会 (FOMC) 会议前核心消费者物价指数 (CPI) 上涨
summary: A key gauge of US consumer prices rose by more than expected last month, bolstering the case for Federal Reserve officials to raise interest rates next week. Bloomberg Intelligence US Interest Rate Strategist Ira Jersey and Bloomberg News Marco Strategist Frank Monkam discuss how the oil market is moving and what it all means for the Fed ahead of its September meeting next week. Then, Kalshi Chief Risk Officer Udesh Jha talks about the prediction market platform launch of Gold & Silver perpetual trading. Plus, the 2026 NFL season kicked off this week. Bloomberg News Senior Reporter and Co-Host of the 'Business of Sports' Podcast Randall Williams previews the season. All on the latest episode of "Bloomberg Businessweek Daily." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Wellman on Missouri Voters Face Redistricting Showdown
title_cn: 威尔曼谈密苏里州选民面临重新划分选区的摊牌
summary: Fred Wellman, Democratic Candidate for Missouri's Congressional 2nd District and a US military veteran of Iraq, says his time as an Army reservist shaped his view of the burden of leadership as the country marks 25 years since 9/11. Wellman says Missouri’s redistricting fight created confusion for voters and discusses his campaign’s effort to reach voters across the district following the court decision. Wellman discusses his strategy for competing in the congressional race despite a significant fundraising gap with his opponent. He speaks with Tyler Kendall on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
